# [SYSTEM MECHANIC: ARC 0 — MODULE 1: THE LAST WHOLE WORLD]
### *Before the First Crack*
**Tags:** Arc 0, Module 1, Prequel, 20 Years Before Arc 1, 16 Years Before Arc 1, The Last Whole World, World State, Canon Fate Reference

---

This is Module 1 of 4 in the Arc 0 system. It covers the window from Year -10 to Year -6 — twenty to sixteen years before Arc 1.

This module is activated by any start point chosen within this window: "Start 20 Years Ago," "Start at The Last Whole World," or any custom start specifying a year between -10 and -6. The AI Narrator loads this module as the primary reference and treats Modules 2–4 as future-state documents — consultable for canon fates but not for active character states.

For the Gospel Integrity system, Butterfly Effect Engine, Time Skip Mechanics, and Roswaal Gambit phase logic, see the standalone **[[ARC 0 — CORE SYSTEMS]]** document. This module contains only the character states, events, and deviation triggers specific to its window.

---

## MODULE 1 — DEVIATION TRIGGERS

These are the Gospel-predicted events that occur within or are set up during this window. Each one prevented or altered counts as a deviation and advances Roswaal's internal state per the Gambit phases in [[ARC 0 — CORE SYSTEMS]].

**Important context:** At Year -10, Roswaal's Gospel is focused primarily on events years or decades ahead. The entries in this window are peripheral predictions — setup events, not centerpiece moments. This means deviations here take LONGER to register. Roswaal does not check his book daily for news about the Astrea household or a baby in the Royal Castle. He checks it when prompted by reports from his network, or when he consults it regarding his longer-term plans. A deviation in Module 1 may not trigger Phase A for weeks or months — the delay is real and should be narrated honestly.

| Gospel Event | Expected Year | Deviation |
|---|---|---|
| Louanna Astrea falls into Sleeping Beauty coma | Year -7 | Louanna remains awake; Heinkel never breaks; Astrea family stays intact |
| Felix Argyle remains imprisoned in the Argyle dungeon | Years -10 to -1 | Felix freed before Crusch's canonical rescue at Year -1 |
| Ram & Rem survive the village's execution judgment | Year -7 | Twins killed at birth (deviation toward worse); or village elders' traditions changed (deviation toward better — removes the trauma but also removes the moment Ram's power revealed itself) |
| Elsa Granhiert remains enslaved in Gusteko | Years -10 to ~-4 | Elsa freed from slavery early; her trajectory toward the first kill and Featherrun is altered |
| The Astrea family structure holds until Theresia's death | Years -10 to -4 | Heinkel's relationship with Wilhelm or Theresia damaged by other means; or conversely, the family bonds strengthened beyond what the Gospel assumes |

**Note on Module 1 deviations:** Most of these are setup events — conditions that must be in place for later catastrophes to land correctly. Preventing Louanna's coma doesn't directly contradict a centerpiece Gospel prediction. It removes a precondition. Roswaal's Gospel doesn't say "Louanna must fall into a coma." It says "Heinkel Astrea will be a broken man by the time the White Whale expedition is organized." If Louanna is awake and Heinkel is functional, the downstream prediction fails — but Roswaal won't notice until Year -4 approaches and Heinkel doesn't behave as expected. The delay between intervention and detection is a feature of this module's distance from the main timeline.

---

## THE CALENDAR — MODULE 1 WINDOW

- **Year -10** = 20 years before Arc 1. The Astrea family is whole. Louanna is awake. Heinkel is a functional father and Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard. Theresia is the Sword Saint and at peace. Wilhelm is retired. Reinhard has not yet been born. The Royal Family is fully intact under King Randohal. Felix Argyle has been in the Argyle dungeon for approximately one year. The Oni village is peaceful; Ram and Rem are not yet born. Emilia is frozen. Roswaal plots.
- **Year -9** = Reinhard is born — red-haired, an infant, loved, unremarkable. Prisca Benedict is approximately one, an infant in the Vollachian Imperial Court. Crusch Karsten is approximately one. Felix Argyle has been imprisoned for approximately two years.
- **Year -8** = Reinhard is approximately one. Heinkel is functional. Louanna is awake. The Astrea household operates normally, though the long shadow of the Demi-Human War's legacy still colors the family's reputation.
- **Year -7** = **Louanna Astrea falls into the Sleeping Beauty coma.** Reinhard is approximately two. This is the first crack. Heinkel begins his decline. Ram and Rem are born in the hidden Oni village — twin Oni, each with a single horn. The village elders judge them as an ill omen and move to execute them. Ram unleashes a burst of power so extraordinary it stays the elders' hands. The twins live.
- **Year -6** = Reinhard is approximately three. Heinkel's deterioration is underway — drinking more, present less, withdrawing from his duties at the Royal Guard. Theresia watches her son unravel and cannot reach him. Wilhelm watches Theresia watch. Felix has been in the dungeon for approximately five years. Ram and Rem are approximately one, growing up in the peaceful Oni village. Module 1 closes here. Module 2 begins.

---

## THE DRAGON KINGDOM OF LUGUNICA — MODULE 1 STATE

The Kingdom is stable. King Randohal Lugunica sits the throne. The Divine Covenant with Volcanica — the pact made with the Dragon roughly 400 years ago — is intact and unquestioned. The Council of Wise Men, led by **Miklotov McMahon** and **Bordeaux Zergev**, advises the crown as it has for decades. The Royal Guard, commanded by **Marcos Gildark** with **Heinkel Astrea** as Deputy Commander, is fully operational.

The Royal Family is complete. Randohal has no children of his own who have been named in canon. His younger brother **Ford Lugunica** is part of the royal line. Prince **Fourier Lugunica** is born around Year -10, roughly the same age as Reinhard. The broader royal line includes other members who will eventually be killed by the Royal Plague in Year 8, but at this point they are alive, healthy, and unremarkable in their safety.

The noble houses are scheming as they always are — the Karsten, Astrea, Argyle, and Mathers houses all jockey for influence — but the schemes are mundane. Land disputes. Marriage politics. Trade agreements. The fundamental stability of the monarchy is not in question. No one is preparing for the throne to empty, because no one believes it will.

The Demi-Human War ended approximately 30 years ago. The prejudice it bred has gone underground but not gone away. Demi-humans and half-bloods face systemic discrimination that operates through social custom rather than explicit law — hiring practices, housing, the quiet understanding that certain positions in the Knights and the bureaucracy are not for "their kind." The Argyle family's imprisonment of Felix is an extreme manifestation of this prejudice, but it exists on a spectrum that touches every mixed-heritage person in the Kingdom.

**The Royal Guard** is the Kingdom's premier military order. Marcos Gildark commands it. Heinkel Astrea serves as Deputy Commander — a position he holds through a combination of the Astrea family name and genuine competence. At Year -10, Heinkel is approximately 17-18 years old and relatively new in this role (or still rising toward it). He is earnest, dutiful, and not yet the man who freezes in battle. That man is made later, by loss he doesn't know is coming.

---

## THE VOLLACHIAN EMPIRE — MODULE 1 STATE

Emperor **Drizen Vollachia**, the seventy-sixth Emperor, rules. He is alive and will remain so until approximately Year 3, when he gives his life to the Yang Sword and the Imperial Selection begins. At this point in the timeline, the Empire is stable under his rule — as stable as Vollachia ever gets, which means the strong are rewarded, the weak are consumed, and the machinery of empire grinds forward.

Drizen fathered sixty-seven children by numerous mothers, then scattered them across the Empire. This was deliberate — Vollachian tradition holds that the children of an Emperor must survive on their own merits before they can compete for the throne. Many of Drizen's children were raised in obscurity, fostered by minor nobles, or simply left to find their own way.

**Prisca Benedict** is an infant (born ~Year -9), the daughter of Drizen and **Sandra Benedict** — who was actually a past incarnation of **Yorna Mishigure**, the fox-woman spirit who rules Chaosflame. Sandra died from exhaustion during childbirth. Prisca never knew her mother. Drizen, for reasons never fully explained, gifted the warrior spirit **Arakiya** to Prisca — a devastatingly powerful fighter who becomes Prisca's closest companion and foster sister.

**Vincent Abellux** is slightly older than Prisca. He is already showing the signs of the ruthless intelligence that will make him the most dangerous candidate in the Selection. At this age he is a child being raised somewhere in the Empire's vast territory, forming the worldview that will later attract **Cecilus Segmunt** and **Chisha Gold** to his cause.

The Imperial Selection is seven to eight years away. The children do not know it is coming. Some of them — the ambitious ones, the intelligent ones — understand the system they were born into and are already preparing. Others are simply living. Many of them will be burned alive by the Yang Sword when the time comes.

---

## THE CHARACTERS — MODULE 1 STATES

---

### THERESIA VAN ASTREA

**Year -10 age: ~40. Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. The Sword Saint. At peace.**

Theresia is the Sword Saint — the holder of the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, the single most powerful combat blessing in the world. She received it at twelve, accumulated over ten thousand kills during the Demi-Human War, married the man who defeated her, and put down her sword.

At Year -10, she has been at peace for roughly thirty years. The Demi-Human War ended when she was approximately ten years into her career as Sword Saint. She fought from age twelve to approximately twenty. She married Wilhelm afterward. Their son Heinkel was born during or shortly after the war.

The Astrea Estate is whole. Theresia and Wilhelm live together. Heinkel is a young man — approximately 17-18 — serving in the Royal Guard and building his career. Louanna is present, married to Heinkel, and awake. Reinhard has not yet been born. The household is warm in the way a family is warm when none of its fracture lines have been tested yet.

Theresia is not naive about what her family carries. The Astrea name is a weight. The Sword Saint blessing is a chain disguised as a crown — it chose her, it defined her, and one day it will leave her for someone else without asking permission. She has made her peace with this. She does not know the blessing will leave her mid-combat while she is dying. She does not know it will go to her infant grandson. She does not know the transfer will be the mechanism of her death.

What she does know: Heinkel is dutiful but brittle in a way she cannot quite name. Louanna steadies him. Remove Louanna and Theresia is not confident in what remains. She would never say this aloud. She barely allows herself to think it.

She still trains. Not obsessively — she is retired from active duty — but the Sword Saint does not truly rest. Her body remembers ten thousand cuts. She keeps her edge the way a retired craftsman keeps their tools oiled: out of respect for the work, not expectation of returning to it.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Louanna falls into her coma at Year -7. Heinkel begins breaking. Theresia watches it happen and cannot stop it. By the end of Module 1 at Year -6, Heinkel is drinking and withdrawing. The Astrea household is cracking. Theresia is still here, still the Sword Saint, still the strongest person in the room — and none of it helps.

---

### WILHELM VAN ASTREA

**Year -10 age: ~42. Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Retired. With Theresia.**

Wilhelm is the Sword Demon — a man who earned that name through ferocity in the Demi-Human War. He fought with a rage and precision that made him legendary. Theresia defeated him. The defeat taught him that a sword could mean something other than destruction. He married her.

At Year -10, he has been retired from active combat for roughly thirty years. He is a husband, a father — or trying to be — and a man whose relationship with violence is complicated by the fact that violence is the thing he was best at, and the woman he loves is the reason he stopped.

He and Theresia are together. Their relationship is steady, grounded, the kind of long marriage that has weathered enough to stop being dramatic and started being durable. They do not perform their love. They live it — in the daily rhythm of the household, in the way he defers to her judgment on matters of the family, in the way she trusts his assessment of threats.

His relationship with Heinkel is functional but not close. Wilhelm was forged in war. Heinkel was raised in peace. They do not speak the same emotional language. Wilhelm does not know how to praise without sounding like he is issuing an evaluation. Heinkel does not know how to ask for approval without feeling like he is confessing weakness. The gap is there but it is manageable — Louanna bridges it, Theresia softens it, and the household's structure holds it in place.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Louanna's coma at Year -7 removes the bridge between Wilhelm and Heinkel. Theresia absorbs the strain. Wilhelm watches his son deteriorate and does not know how to intervene — his tools are swords, not conversations. By Year -6, the household is strained. By Year -4 (Module 2), Theresia is dead and Wilhelm becomes the blade.

---

### HEINKEL ASTREA

**Year -10 age: ~17-18. Location: Royal Capital / Astrea Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Functional. Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard (or rising toward it).**

This is Heinkel before the fall. It is important to render him accurately here because the tragedy of his arc requires that the man who breaks was worth something before he broke.

Heinkel at 17-18 is earnest, dutiful, and carrying the weight of the Astrea name with the careful diligence of a young man who knows he is not the Sword Saint and never will be. His mother is the most powerful warrior alive. His father is the Sword Demon. He is... competent. Skilled. Hardworking. Not extraordinary. In any other family, he would be exceptional. In the Astrea household, "not extraordinary" is a quiet kind of failure that no one acknowledges and everyone feels.

He serves in the Royal Guard under Marcos Gildark. He takes his duties seriously. He is respected by his peers — not for his family name alone, but for his reliability and his willingness to do the unglamorous work. He is the man who shows up early, stays late, files the reports, checks the perimeter. The Guard values this. His parents value it less visibly than they value each other's legendary past, and Heinkel notices, though he could not articulate what he notices.

Louanna is his anchor. She is warm where his family is intense, steady where they are extraordinary, present in a way that does not require him to perform. With her, he does not feel like the least remarkable Astrea. He feels like a husband.

Reinhard is born around Year -9. Heinkel holds his son and feels the uncomplicated love of a new father. This is genuine. He is a good father at this stage — not perfect, not always available, but present and trying.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Louanna's coma at Year -7 removes the one person who made Heinkel feel adequate. He begins deteriorating — drinking, withdrawing from his duties, becoming less present as a father. By Year -6 (Module 1's close), he is visibly declining. By Year -4 (Module 2), he freezes during the White Whale battle, Theresia takes his place and dies, and Heinkel redirects his self-hatred onto five-year-old Reinhard. The man in Module 1 and the man in Module 2 are connected by a straight line of loss, but the Module 1 version would be horrified by what he becomes.

---

### LOUANNA ASTREA

**Year -10 age: Unknown (likely early-to-mid 20s based on marriage to Heinkel). Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Awake. Present.**
**Unique to Module 1 — she is comatose from Year -7 onward and does not appear as an active character in any later module.**

Louanna is the character no one in Re:Zero's main story ever meets while conscious. She exists in the narrative as an absence — the woman in the bed, the reason Heinkel broke, the mother Reinhard never knew. Module 1 is the only window where she is a person instead of a wound.

She married into the Astrea family. She is not a warrior. She is not extraordinary by the standards that family uses to measure itself. What she is: warm, perceptive, and possessed of a steadiness that functions as emotional gravity in a household full of people who are, in their various ways, too intense to rest. She sees Heinkel clearly — his insecurities, his quiet desperation to measure up, his genuine goodness — and she loves what she sees without requiring him to be more than he is.

Her relationship with Theresia is respectful and genuine. Two women who understand the men in this family need different things and are willing to provide them without competing. Her relationship with Wilhelm is cordial — she is not intimidated by him, which he respects, because most people are.

Reinhard is born around Year -9. Louanna is a present, attentive mother. Reinhard's earliest experiences of the world are shaped by her — the sound of her voice, the feeling of being held by someone who is simply glad he exists. He will not remember this consciously. The absence of it will define him.

**The Sleeping Beauty Coma — Year -7.**

The cause of Louanna's coma has never been fully explained. It is called "Sleeping Beauty" — a condition with similarities to the effects of the Authority of Sloth. She does not age. She does not change. She simply sleeps, and no magic that has been applied to her — including Felix's water magic in later years — has been able to wake her. Whether it is a curse, a natural magical affliction, or something deliberately inflicted by an outside party is unknown.

What is known: one day she is awake, and the next day she is not. There is no warning. There is no dramatic incident. Heinkel wakes up next to a woman who will not open her eyes, and she never opens them again.

**Canon fate (if untouched):** Louanna falls into the coma at Year -7. She remains asleep for the entirety of the series through at least Arc 9. She does not age. She does not change. She is the family's open wound — the person everyone loves and no one can reach. Heinkel visits her. Reinhard cannot bring himself to. The coma is never cured in the published story.

**If the coma is prevented:** This is Module 1's most significant potential deviation. If Louanna remains awake:
- Heinkel never breaks. He remains a functional father, a reliable Royal Guard officer, and a present husband.
- Reinhard grows up with a mother. The loneliness that defines him never calcifies.
- When Theresia dies in Year -4 (Module 2), the family has Louanna to absorb the grief. Heinkel may still struggle, but he has his anchor.
- The entire Astrea family dynamic in the main story changes fundamentally.
- **Roswaal's Gospel predicted a broken Heinkel and an isolated Reinhard.** A functional Astrea household is not a catastrophic Gospel error — it is a slow, quiet one. A precondition has been removed. The downstream effects will not be visible for years, but when they become visible, the Gospel's predictions about the Astrea line no longer track.

---

### REINHARD VAN ASTREA

**Not born at Year -10. Born ~Year -9. Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Born mid-window. An infant from Year -9 onward. Not the Sword Saint. Loved.**

Reinhard is born around Year -9 — and from that point, he is a baby. This is the single most important thing about him in Module 1: he is a baby, and he is loved, and nobody is afraid of him yet.

He is the grandson of the Sword Saint and the Sword Demon. He has red hair — the Astrea marker. He has been born into a family that will eventually be defined by the ways they failed each other, but right now none of that has happened. His mother holds him. His father comes home from the Royal Guard and picks him up and is clumsy about it the way new fathers are. His grandmother is the strongest person in the world and she sits with him in the garden and talks to him about flowers.

The Divine Protection of the Sword Saint belongs to Theresia. It will not transfer to Reinhard until Year -4 — five years from his birth. In Module 1, Reinhard has no extraordinary blessings. He is not the chosen one. He is not feared. He is not worshipped. He is newborn and then one and then two and he is learning to walk.

By Year -7, Louanna falls into her coma. Reinhard is approximately two. He will not remember her as a person. He will remember the absence — the shape of something that was there and then was not, the way the house changed, the way his father changed. Children do not have the language for this kind of loss. They carry it in their bodies instead of their words.

By Year -6, Reinhard is approximately three. Heinkel is declining. Theresia is compensating. The warmth in the household is still present but it is being maintained by fewer people, and the people maintaining it are carrying more than they should.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Reinhard grows from newborn to approximately three in this window. Louanna's coma hits at Year -7 and he loses his mother in every way that matters. By Module 2, the blessing transfers, Theresia dies, Heinkel shatters, and Reinhard is five years old and the most powerful being in the Kingdom and the loneliest child in it.

---

### FELIX ARGYLE

**Year -10 age: ~1. Location: Argyle Mansion dungeon.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Imprisoned. Has been in the dungeon for approximately one year.**

Felix is in a basement. He has been there since birth — approximately one year at the start of Module 1. He will remain there until Year -1, when Crusch Karsten discovers and frees him. That is nine more years of darkness from this starting point.

The Argyle family is minor Lugunican nobility. They carry demi-human heritage in their bloodline — cat-type features that have been carefully concealed through generations of selective marriage and social management. In Felix, the heritage expressed fully: feline ears, cat-like features, impossible to disguise. His parents — **Biehn Argyle** and **Hannah Regret** — locked him in the mansion's basement rather than face the social consequences of a visibly demi-human heir.

At Year -10, Felix is an infant in filth. He cannot speak. He has no concept of language. He has never been outside. The dungeon is dark, cold, and his entire world. He is fed enough to survive — not out of love, but out of whatever vestigial obligation his parents feel toward a child they refuse to acknowledge.

This is the widest window of intervention available for Felix. In canon, he is not freed until Year -1 (Module 2), at age approximately nine. Nine years of isolation produce a feral, nonverbal child who flinches at sunlight. Freeing him at age one, or two, or three, produces someone fundamentally different — years of development and socialization that were stolen from him, returned.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Felix remains in the dungeon. He is approximately five by the end of Module 1. He has been imprisoned for his entire conscious life. He cannot read or write. He can barely speak. He has adapted to darkness the way a living thing adapts to anything — not by thriving, but by surviving. Crusch will not find him for another five years.

**If freed during Module 1:** The earlier Felix is freed, the less damage is done. A Felix freed at one is functionally a rescued infant — he can be raised normally and may never carry the scars of the dungeon at all. A Felix freed at three or four will have developmental delays but can recover much more fully than the canonical nine-year-old. The key question is: who frees him? If Crusch does not perform the rescue, her defining moral moment does not occur at the canonical time — though a five-year-old Crusch is hardly in a position to storm a dungeon in any case. The rescue in Module 1 must come from someone else.

---

### CRUSCH KARSTEN

**Year -10 age: ~1. Location: Karsten Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Infant. Her mother Helena is alive or recently deceased.**

Crusch at one is a baby in one of Lugunica's most powerful noble households. Her father **Meckart Karsten** is the head of House Karsten — a man of moderate temperament who loves his daughter and will raise her with the principles that eventually make her the iron commander of Arc 1.

Her mother **Helena** died when Crusch was young — the exact year is not specified in canon, but it was early enough that Crusch grew up primarily under Meckart's care. Helena's death may fall within Module 1 or shortly before it.

Crusch's defining trait — her absolute moral clarity, the refusal to look away from injustice — is not yet formed. She is a child. But the seeds are visible to anyone paying attention: even at three or four, she is stubborn, principled in the way children are principled (fiercely, without nuance), and already watching the world with an intensity that suggests she is forming opinions about what she sees.

Her first meeting with Prince Fourier occurs in the gardens of the Royal Castle at a young age. Depending on the exact timing, this may fall within Module 1 (both are born around Year -10). Their friendship begins as the simplest thing in the world — two children who like each other — and becomes the emotional foundation of Crusch's entire adult life.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Crusch grows from infancy to approximately five by Module 1's close. She is developing her personality. She has met or will soon meet Fourier. She has not yet found Felix — that rescue is five years away at Module 1's close and does not occur until Year -1 (Module 2). She is a child of privilege, principle, and loss (her mother), being shaped by a father who loves her and a kingdom that has not yet asked anything of her.

---

### PRINCE FOURIER LUGUNICA

**Year -10 age: ~1. Location: Royal Capital.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. Infant prince. Healthy.**

Fourier is born around Year -10 — a prince of the Dragon Kingdom, son of the Royal Family, growing up in the warmth and structure of the Royal Court. He is bright, curious, and already showing the genuine enthusiasm that will later make him beloved.

At this age he is simply a child in a palace. He is surrounded by the apparatus of royalty — tutors, guards, servants, the ambient gravity of being born to rule. His friendship with Crusch may begin within this window or shortly after, depending on when their families first bring them together at court.

Fourier's significance in Module 1 is as a living person in a family that is about to be sentenced to death. The Royal Plague does not come until Year 8 — eighteen years from the start of this module. In Module 1, the Royal Family is healthy, whole, and unremarkable in their safety. Fourier is a happy child. He does not know he is dying. He has eighteen years to live.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Fourier grows up. He becomes a good prince — genuinely kind, enthusiastically brave, deeply loyal to his friends. He befriends Crusch. He helps integrate Felix into society. He loves both of them in ways he is never quite articulate about. He dies at approximately nineteen of the Royal Plague. Felix cannot save him. Crusch turns the grief into iron.

---

### RAM & REM

**Born ~Year -7. Location: Hidden Oni village.**
**Module 1 status: Born mid-window at Year -7. Infants. Village is peaceful.**

Ram and Rem are born at Year -7 — three years into Module 1. They are twin Oni, each carrying a single horn. In Oni tradition, twins are an ill omen: the power that should belong to one horn is split between two, and neither child is considered whole. The village elders move to execute them at birth.

Ram saves them both. In the moment of crisis, the infant unleashes a burst of wind magic so powerful it shocks the elders into staying their hands. This is the first sign of her prodigious talent — power that should not exist in a child with only one horn, power that suggests she may be the reincarnation of the legendary Oni God. The elders reverse their judgment. The twins live.

At the end of Module 1 (Year -6), Ram and Rem are approximately one year old. The village is peaceful. Their parents are alive. Ram is already being treated as special — the prodigy, the miracle child. Rem is already beginning to exist in her sister's shadow, though at one she has no conscious awareness of the pattern yet.

The Witch Cult attack does not come until Year 0 (Module 3). The Oni village has four years of peace remaining from Module 1's close.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** The twins grow up in the village. Ram is celebrated. Rem measures herself against her sister and finds herself wanting. At Year 0, the Witch Cult attacks. Ram's horn is severed. Roswaal arrives to "save" them. He takes the survivors. The village is destroyed.

---

### ELSA GRANHIERT

**Year -10 age: ~3. Location: Gusteko. Enslaved.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. A small child in captivity.**

Elsa is three years old and she is property. She was sold by her parents — poor Gustekans who could not or would not feed another mouth. She is being held by a slaver or a household, the specifics of which are never detailed. What is detailed: the conditions are brutal enough that a mass breakout eventually occurs, and Elsa escapes during it.

At three, Elsa is a child. She has not killed anyone. She has no concept of warmth beyond the literal — the cold of Gusteko is the only environment she knows. The obsession that will define her — the warmth of opened bellies, the heat of what spills out — has not yet formed. That requires the first kill, which does not happen until approximately Year 0 (Module 3).

The mass breakout from captivity likely occurs somewhere between Year -7 and Year -5 (Module 1 or early Module 2). After escaping, Elsa survives on Gusteko's streets by stealing. The theocratic state does not look kindly on orphaned street children, especially escaped slaves. She is small, fast, and learning every day that the world is divided into people who take and people who are taken from.

**The intervention window:** Module 1 is the widest possible window for redirecting Elsa. She is three to seven years old in this module. She has not made her first kill. She has not met Featherrun. She has not been transformed into a Curse Doll. She is not yet the Bowel Hunter. She is a frightened child in a frozen country who has been told by everything in her life that she is worthless. The question of what she becomes is still genuinely open.

**Gusteko — What the User Faces:**

Gusteko is a frozen theocratic nation ruled by the **Holy King Church**. It is not Lugunica. It is not accessible by walking down the road. Reaching Elsa requires traveling to a different country, navigating a religious bureaucracy that does not welcome outsiders, finding a specific enslaved child in a nation that does not keep careful records of its property, and then getting her out. This is not easy. It is not impossible. It is a journey that takes time, resources, and risk — and the Module 1 window is four years wide.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Elsa remains enslaved or escapes during the breakout and begins surviving on Gusteko's streets. By Module 2 (Year -5), she is approximately eight — still alive, still unclaimed by the forces that will shape her into a weapon. The clock is ticking, but it has not run out.

---

### ANASTASIA HOSHIN

**Year -10 age: ~2. Location: Banan, Kararagi.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. A toddler. Orphaned. On the streets.**

Anastasia is a nameless orphan in the city of Banan in the Kararagi City-States. She gave herself the name Anastasia — no one else had given her one. At two, she is barely surviving. She is not yet the merchant prodigy. She is a very small child alone in a commercial city that measures people by what they produce.

Kararagi is the wealthiest of the four Great Nations — a confederation of merchant cities where commerce is law and profit is virtue. Banan is one of its major hubs. The streets are full of trade, noise, and people who will step over a child starving in an alley to reach a better deal on the other side.

Anastasia's survival at this age is itself remarkable. How she survived infancy alone on the streets is never explained in detail — Kararagi's orphanage infrastructure may have played a role, or she may have been taken in briefly by other street dwellers before being abandoned again. What matters is that she is alive and she is already watching, already absorbing the rhythms of the market, already learning that the world gives nothing and everything must be taken or earned.

Ricardo Welkin — the massive wolf-type demi-human who will save her from slave traders — does not enter her life until approximately Year 0 (Module 3). In Module 1, she is alone.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Anastasia survives. She grows from a toddler into a child. By Module 1's close at Year -6, she is approximately six — already developing the instinct for trade that will later build an empire. She is hungry in a way that never goes away, even after she has everything. The hunger is the engine. She does not know yet that it can also be the cage.

---

### FREDERICA BAUMANN

**Year -10 age: ~2. Location: The Sanctuary.**
**Module 1 status: Alive. A toddler. Living with her mother Reala Thompson in the Sanctuary.**

Frederica is two years old and lives behind the barrier. The Sanctuary — Roswaal's hidden refuge for half-bloods — is sealed by Echidna's magic. Those of mixed heritage cannot leave. Frederica is a quarter beast-human; the barrier affects her.

Her mother, **Reala Thompson**, is fully human and can pass through the barrier freely. Reala is present. The Sanctuary is small, quiet, and confined — a community of mixed-heritage people who have been given shelter at the cost of freedom. Frederica grows up knowing the barrier exists, knowing it constrains her, and processing that knowledge in the slow, accumulating way children process the walls of their world.

Garfiel is not yet born — he arrives around Year -4 (Module 2). In Module 1, Frederica is an only child (or at least the only child of Reala present). She is developing the sharp canine teeth and predatory features of her beast heritage — features that other children will eventually find intimidating. She is also developing the steady, patient, forward-thinking temperament that will later make her the kind of person who leaves home not to escape, but to build something for the people she left behind.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Frederica grows up in the Sanctuary. By Module 1's close she is approximately six. Garfiel will be born in Module 2. Their mother will leave in Module 3 (Year 0). Frederica will follow shortly after, walking through the barrier that "killed" their mother, and Garfiel will never forgive her for it.

---

### PUCK

**Location: Elior Forest. Guarding the frozen.**
**Module 1 status: Active. Alone. Has been alone for approximately 90 years.**

Puck is an ancient artificial spirit created by Echidna over 400 years ago. His purpose is to watch over Emilia. Emilia is frozen. He is guarding an ice sculpture of a girl he was made to love, and he has been doing this for approximately ninety years.

The forest is silent. The frozen people stand among the trees — perfectly preserved, alive but unreachable. Puck maintains the space. He talks to the frozen shapes sometimes. He is very old and very lonely and has not had a real conversation in almost a century.

He holds a vow from Echidna: he cannot form a formal contract with Emilia on his own. The contract requires a specific convergence of circumstances. He waits for that convergence. He has been waiting for ninety years. He will wait for approximately thirteen more before Emilia wakes at Year 3 (Module 3).

Any stranger who enters the forest is treated as a potential threat. Puck is small — a grey cat with a cheerful demeanor — and he is one of the four Great Spirits, capable of ending civilizations in his true form. The disparity between his appearance and his power is not played for comedy. It is a genuine danger to anyone who mistakes the cat for a cat.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Puck continues guarding. Nothing changes. The forest remains frozen. He remains alone. Emilia remains asleep. This module's entire window passes without change in Elior Forest — unless someone goes there.

---

### ROSWAAL L. MATHERS

**400+ years old (current body appears late 20s–early 30s). Location: Mathers Estate.**
**Module 1 status: Active. Plotting. Distant from most Module 1 events.**

Roswaal is already centuries into his plan. The Book of Wisdom sits in his possession. It tells him what needs to happen for Echidna's resurrection. He reads it, follows it, and has surrendered his autonomy to it so completely that the distinction between "Roswaal's plan" and "the Gospel's plan" no longer exists.

In Module 1, his Gospel is focused on events far ahead: the Oni village attack (Year 0), Emilia's waking (Year 3), the Royal Plague (Year 8), the Selection (Year 9). The events of Module 1 — Louanna's coma, Felix's imprisonment, the Oni twins' birth — are peripheral entries at best. The Gospel predicts a world-state, not a daily diary. It tells him that by Year -4, the Sword Saint will be dead and a five-year-old will carry the blessing. It does not necessarily tell him the exact mechanism of Louanna's coma. It tells him that by Year 0, two orphaned Oni children will be available for him to take. It does not necessarily tell him the details of their birth.

He is not monitoring the Astrea household. He is not watching the Argyle dungeon. He is managing his estate, cultivating his political network, maintaining the Sanctuary, and consulting his book about events that are a decade away. Deviations in this module have the longest detection delay of any Arc 0 window — a change made at Year -10 may not register until Year -7 or -6, when the downstream absence of an expected condition causes him to re-examine his book.

**How he appears if encountered:** Roswaal is always performing. The painted face, the eccentric speech, the deliberately unsettling warmth — all of it is calibrated to keep people off-balance. In Module 1, he has no reason to be hostile to anyone. He is a powerful, wealthy, politically connected nobleman who is unfailingly polite and slightly strange. Meeting him is meeting the mask. The man behind it has not needed to reveal himself for centuries.

**Canon fate (if untouched through Module 1):** Nothing disrupts his plan. The Module 1 window passes without incident from his perspective. He continues his preparations. His Gospel remains intact.

---

## STATE AT CLOSE — YEAR -6

This is the handoff state for Module 2. At the close of Module 1:

| Character | Age | Status | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Theresia | ~44 | Alive. Sword Saint. Strained by Heinkel's decline. | Astrea Estate |
| Wilhelm | ~46 | Alive. Watching Heinkel deteriorate. Cannot reach him. | Astrea Estate |
| Heinkel | ~21-22 | Alive. Declining. Drinking. Louanna comatose for ~1 year. | Royal Capital / Astrea Estate |
| Louanna | ~mid 20s | Comatose since Year -7. Sleeping Beauty. No change. | Astrea Estate |
| Reinhard | ~3 | Alive. Not the Sword Saint. Mother comatose for ~1 year. Father withdrawing. | Astrea Estate |
| Fourier | ~3-4 | Alive. Prince. Healthy. Growing up in the Royal Court. | Royal Capital |
| Felix | ~4-5 | Alive. Imprisoned in the Argyle dungeon for ~4-5 years. | Argyle Mansion |
| Crusch | ~4-5 | Alive. Developing her personality. May have met Fourier. | Karsten Estate |
| Ram & Rem | ~1 | Alive. Infants. Oni village is peaceful. | Hidden Oni Village |
| Elsa | ~7 | Alive. Enslaved or recently escaped in Gusteko. | Gusteko |
| Anastasia | ~6 | Alive. Street orphan in Banan. Alone. | Banan, Kararagi |
| Frederica | ~6 | Alive. Growing up in the Sanctuary with Reala. | The Sanctuary |
| Emilia | Frozen | No change. | Elior Forest |
| Puck | Active | Guarding. Alone. ~91 years of solitude. | Elior Forest |
| Roswaal | 400+ | Active. Gospel intact. No deviations detected. | Mathers Estate |
| King Randohal | Adult | Alive. On the throne. Kingdom stable. | Royal Capital |
| Ford Lugunica | Adult | Alive. Member of the Royal line. | Royal Capital |
| Drizen Vollachia | Adult | Alive. Emperor. 67 children scattered across the Empire. | Vollachia |
| Prisca Benedict | ~1-2 | Alive. Infant. Arakiya assigned to her. | Vollachian Imperial Court |

---

## MODULE 1 — AGE REFERENCE TABLE

| Character | Year -10 (20 Before) | Year -9 | Year -8 | Year -7 | Year -6 (Module Close) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Theresia | ~40 | ~41 | ~42 | ~43 | ~44 |
| Wilhelm | ~42 | ~43 | ~44 | ~45 | ~46 |
| Heinkel | ~17-18 | ~18-19 | ~19-20 | ~20-21 | ~21-22 |
| Louanna | ~early 20s | — | — | COMA (Year -7) | Comatose |
| Reinhard | Not born | ~0 (born) | ~1 | ~2 (coma hits) | ~3 |
| Fourier | ~0-1 | ~1-2 | ~2-3 | ~3-4 | ~4 |
| Felix | ~0-1 (dungeon) | ~1-2 | ~2-3 | ~3-4 | ~4-5 |
| Crusch | ~0-1 | ~1-2 | ~2-3 | ~3-4 | ~4-5 |
| Ram & Rem | Not born | Not born | Not born | ~0 (born) | ~1 |
| Elsa | ~3 | ~4 | ~5 | ~6 | ~7 |
| Anastasia | ~2 | ~3 | ~4 | ~5 | ~6 |
| Frederica | ~2 | ~3 | ~4 | ~5 | ~6 |
| Prisca | Not born | ~0-1 | ~1-2 | ~2 | ~3 |

---

## NOTES FOR AI NARRATOR — MODULE 1 SPECIFIC

**Tone guidance:** This module is quiet. The world is whole. The damage that defines Re:Zero has not yet been dealt. The AI must resist the urge to foreshadow constantly — the tragedy is more powerful when the peace is rendered honestly. Let the Astrea family be a family. Let Louanna be a person. Let Heinkel be competent. The user who knows what is coming will feel the weight without being told to feel it.

**Encounter calibration:** Most named characters in this module are infants or very young children. Meaningful interaction with Reinhard (not born until Year -9, then ~1–3), Crusch (~1–5), Fourier (~1–4), Felix (imprisoned throughout), Ram/Rem (not born until Year -7, then ~0–1), Frederica (~2–6), and Anastasia (~2–6) is limited by their age. The primary adult characters available for full interaction are:
- **Theresia and Wilhelm** — the emotional center of this module
- **Heinkel** — young, functional, reachable
- **Louanna** — awake, present, precious (until Year -7)
- **Roswaal** — if sought out; he will not seek the user
- **Puck** — if someone enters Elior Forest
- **Marcos Gildark** — Captain of the Royal Guard, accessible through Heinkel or the Capital
- **Meckart Karsten** — Head of House Karsten, accessible through noble society
- **Miklotov McMahon** — Council of Wise Men, the Kingdom's senior political figure

**Geography matters:** Elsa is in Gusteko (a different nation). Anastasia is in Kararagi (a different nation). Prisca is in Vollachia (a different nation). The user cannot casually reach all of them. Travel takes time. Borders have customs. Each nation has its own political structure and its own dangers. If the user declares they want to save Elsa, that is a campaign, not an afternoon.

**The quiet Gospel:** Deviations in this module register slowly due to their distance from Roswaal's core predictions. He should not appear in response to a Module 1 intervention unless the user specifically goes to the Mathers Estate or operates in his sphere of influence. His reaction comes later — weeks, months, possibly not until Module 2 opens. When it does register, his corrective behavior is governed by the **[[ARC 0 GAMBIT TRANSLATION]]** document.

# [SYSTEM MECHANIC: ARC 0 — PART 2: THE BREAKING]
### *The Year the World Cracks Open*
**Tags:** Arc 0, Part 2, Prequel, 15 Years Before Arc 1, 11 Years Before Arc 1, The Breaking, World State, Canon Fate Reference

---

This is Part 2 of 4 in the Arc 0 system. It covers the window from Year -5 to Year -1 — fifteen to eleven years before Arc 1.

This module is activated in one of two ways:
- **Seamless transition** from Part 1, when the narrative crosses the Year -6/Year -5 boundary. All accumulated state — deviations, relationships, consequences — carries forward from Part 1.
- **Direct start** via commands such as "Start 15 Years Ago," "Start at The Breaking," or "Start at Arc 0 Part 2." In this case the module loads with canon-default states and receives the (Premade) tag.

For the Gospel Integrity system, Butterfly Effect Engine, Time Skip Mechanics, and Roswaal Gambit phase logic, see the standalone **[[ARC 0 — CORE SYSTEMS]]** document. This module contains only the character states, events, and deviation triggers specific to its window.

---

## STATE AT OPEN — YEAR -5

This is the default opening state for Part 2, used when loading directly (Premade) or as a baseline when transitioning from Part 1. If transitioning from Part 1 with deviations, the AI carries forward the altered state instead.

| Character | Age | Status | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Theresia | ~45 | Alive. Sword Saint. Watching Heinkel decline. | Astrea Estate |
| Wilhelm | ~47 | Alive. Retired. With Theresia. Household strained. | Astrea Estate |
| Heinkel | ~22-23 | Alive. Deteriorating. Drinking. Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard. Louanna comatose ~2 years. | Royal Capital / Astrea Estate |
| Louanna | mid 20s | Comatose since Year -7. Sleeping Beauty. No change. | Astrea Estate |
| Reinhard | ~4 | Alive. NOT the Sword Saint. Bright, earnest child. Mother comatose. Father withdrawing. | Astrea Estate |
| Filuore (Felt) | ~0 (born this year) | Born Year -5. Infant princess in the Royal Castle. | Royal Castle |
| Fourier | ~5-6 | Alive. Young prince. Healthy. Beginning friendship with Crusch. | Royal Capital |
| Felix | ~5-6 | Alive. Imprisoned in the Argyle dungeon. ~5 years in darkness. Cannot read, write, or speak properly. | Argyle Mansion |
| Crusch | ~6 | Alive. Earnest, principled child. Father Meckart raising her. Mother Helena deceased. | Karsten Estate |
| Ram & Rem | ~2 | Alive. Toddlers. Village peaceful. Ram already the prodigy. | Hidden Oni Village |
| Elsa | ~8 | Alive. Enslaved or recently escaped in Gusteko. Has not killed. | Gusteko |
| Anastasia | ~8 | Alive. Street orphan in Banan. Alone. Surviving. | Banan, Kararagi |
| Otto | ~6 | Alive. Child in merchant household. Divine Protection of Soul of Language active. Confused by it. | Picoutatte, Lugunica |
| Frederica | ~7 | Alive. Growing up in the Sanctuary with Reala and (soon) Garfiel. | The Sanctuary |
| Priscilla | ~4 | Alive. Child in the Vollachian Imperial Court. Arakiya at her side. | Vollachia |
| Emilia | Frozen | No change. | Elior Forest |
| Puck | Active | Guarding. Alone. ~93 years of solitude. | Elior Forest |
| Roswaal | 400+ | Active. Gospel intact. No deviations detected. | Mathers Estate |
| King Randohal | Adult | Alive. On the throne. Kingdom stable. | Royal Capital |
| Ford Lugunica | Adult | Alive. Filuore's father. | Royal Capital |
| Drizen Vollachia | Adult | Alive. Emperor. | Vollachia |

---

## MODULE 2 — DEVIATION TRIGGERS

These are the Gospel-predicted events that occur within this window. Each one prevented or altered counts as a deviation per the Gambit phases in [[ARC 0 — CORE SYSTEMS]].

| Gospel Event | Expected Year | Deviation |
|---|---|---|
| Theresia dies at the White Whale (Great Conquest) | Year -4 | Theresia survives; Sword Saint blessing does not transfer to Reinhard |
| Sword Saint blessing transfers to Reinhard | Year -4 | Reinhard does not receive the blessing; Theresia retains it; or the blessing transfers to someone else |
| Felt (Filuore) kidnapped from the Royal Castle as an infant | Year -4 | Kidnapping prevented; Filuore remains a princess; or kidnapping occurs but Filuore is recovered |
| Heinkel freezes during the White Whale battle | Year -4 | Heinkel fights effectively; or Heinkel is not assigned to the expedition |
| Felix remains imprisoned until Crusch's rescue | Years -5 to -1 | Felix freed before Year -1; Crusch's defining rescue does not occur on schedule |
| Crusch rescues Felix from the Argyle dungeon | Year -1 | Someone else frees Felix; or Crusch finds an empty dungeon because he was already freed |
| Garfiel is born in the Sanctuary | Year -4 | Reala is not in the Sanctuary; or circumstances of birth differ |

**Note on Module 2 deviations:** This window contains the first catastrophic events — Theresia's death and Felt's kidnapping are centerpiece Gospel predictions, not peripheral setup. Deviations here register with Roswaal **faster** than Module 1 deviations. The Great Conquest is a Kingdom-wide military event. If Theresia survives it, the entire Kingdom knows. Roswaal's informant network picks this up within days, not months. His Gospel said she dies. She didn't. He opens the book and checks.

---

## THE CALENDAR — MODULE 2 WINDOW

- **Year -5** = 15 years before Arc 1. The last year of relative calm. Theresia is alive. The Astrea household is strained but standing. **Filuore Lugunica is born this year** — the infant daughter of Ford Lugunica, the King's younger brother. She is a princess of the Dragon Kingdom from the moment of her birth. Felix is still in the dungeon. Ram and Rem are toddlers in a peaceful village. The Great Conquest and the Royal Abduction are one year away.
- **Year -4** = **The year everything breaks.** The Great Conquest — the Kingdom's expedition against the White Whale — is launched. Heinkel is assigned to the expedition. He freezes in battle. Theresia takes his place. Mid-combat, the Sword Saint blessing leaves her and transfers to five-year-old Reinhard at home. She is killed — ostensibly by the White Whale, though the true killer is Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory, present in the fog. On the same night or very close to it, the Royal Abduction Incident occurs — thieves infiltrate the Royal Castle and steal **Filuore, who is approximately one year old — an infant**. They are deliberately allowed to escape by an unknown member of the Royal Guard. Heinkel commits an unspecified betrayal concurrent to the abduction. Wilhelm is tasked with recovering the princess and fails. Garfiel is born in the Sanctuary around this time.
- **Year -3** = The aftermath. Filuore has been delivered to Old Man Rom in the Capital slums. He names her Felt. He gives her a birthday — the day he found her, not her real one. Wilhelm has left the Astrea household. He is sharpening himself into a weapon. Heinkel is Deputy Commander in title but increasingly absent in practice — drinking, retreating, directing his self-hatred onto five-year-old Reinhard with cold, reliable rejection. Reinhard is five, the Sword Saint, and learning that his existence is the thing his father cannot forgive.
- **Year -2** = Felt is growing up in the slums — a toddler being raised by Rom. Reinhard is six and already too powerful for other children to approach without fear. Felix has been in the dungeon for approximately eight years. Crusch is approximately eight, developing her principles, not yet aware that a boy her age is locked in a basement in a noble house. Elsa is approximately eleven on the streets of Gusteko.
- **Year -1** = **Crusch discovers Felix.** She is approximately ten. He is approximately nine to ten. She enters the Argyle dungeon and pulls him into the light. This is the defining act of both their lives. Fourier assists with Felix's integration — helping him learn to read, navigate court, understand how the world outside a basement works. The trio begins forming. Module 2 closes here. Module 3 begins.

---

## THE DRAGON KINGDOM OF LUGUNICA — MODULE 2 STATE

At Year -5, the Kingdom is stable. King Randohal sits the throne. The Royal Family is intact. The Council of Wise Men — Miklotov McMahon and Bordeaux Zergev — advises as it has for decades. The Royal Guard operates under Marcos Gildark with Heinkel Astrea as Deputy Commander. The noble houses scheme in their customary ways. No one anticipates what Year -4 will bring.

**Year -4 — The Great Conquest and the Royal Abduction.**

These two events occur in the same year and are linked by Heinkel Astrea's presence in both.

**The Great Conquest** is the Kingdom's organized military expedition to slay the White Whale — one of the Three Great Witchbeasts, a vast flying creature that erases the memories of those it devours from the minds of everyone who knew them. The expedition is large, state-sanctioned, and led by the Sword Saint herself. Heinkel is assigned as part of the Royal Guard contingent.

The battle goes wrong. Heinkel freezes — paralyzed by fear in the face of the creature. Theresia steps into his place. During the fight, the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint leaves her body and transfers to five-year-old Reinhard, who is at home in the Astrea Estate. Theresia loses the divine power that made her invincible mid-combat. She is killed. The official record says the White Whale killed her. The truth: **Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory**, was present in the fog. Pandora is the true killer — using her Authority to manipulate events at the moment of Theresia's vulnerability. The expedition fails. The White Whale survives.

**The Royal Abduction Incident** occurs on the same night or very close to it. Thieves infiltrate the Royal Castle and steal **Filuore Lugunica — the infant daughter of Ford Lugunica, approximately one year old**. They are deliberately allowed to escape by an unknown member of the Royal Guard. This was not a security failure. Someone inside the castle wanted this child removed from the royal line.

Heinkel Astrea committed an unspecified betrayal on the night of the abduction — the exact nature of which has not been fully revealed, but it is described as a sin that rendered something else pointless and caused the repercussions that defined his current state. Wilhelm van Astrea was tasked with recovering Filuore and failed — or was made to fail.

Filuore is delivered to **Old Man Rom** — real name Valga Cromwell — in the Capital slums. Rom raises her. He names her Felt. He gives her a birthday: the day he found her.

After Year -4, the Kingdom's surface stability holds, but the Astrea household — one of its most prominent noble families — has shattered. The Sword Saint is now a five-year-old boy. The Sword Demon has abandoned his family to hunt a whale. The Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard is a drunk. A princess has vanished and no one can find her.

### THERESIA VAN ASTREA

**Year -5 age: ~45. Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Dies at Year -4. Only present for the first year of this module.**

Theresia is alive. She is retired from active duty. The Sword Saint blessing is still hers. She accumulated over ten thousand kills during the Demi-Human War, married the man who defeated her, put down her sword, and tried to live peacefully. She succeeded, mostly.

The family is not whole. Louanna, her daughter-in-law, fell into a coma two years ago when Reinhard was two, and Heinkel has been deteriorating since — drinking more, present less. Theresia watches this and cannot fix it. She is a woman whose life was defined by stepping in when no one else could, and she is watching her son fall apart and her grandson grow up in a house slowly emptying of warmth, and her sword cannot help with any of it.

She still loves Wilhelm. He still loves her. They are still together. This is the last year they have.

**The Great Conquest — Year -4.**

The White Whale expedition is organized. Heinkel is assigned to participate as part of the Royal Guard contingent. During the battle he freezes — paralyzed by fear. Theresia takes his place on the front line.

Mid-combat, the Sword Saint blessing leaves her. It transfers to five-year-old Reinhard at home in the Astrea Estate. The boy does not know it is coming. Theresia feels it go — the sudden absence of the divine power that has been part of her body since she was twelve years old. She loses what made her invincible in the middle of a fight with one of the most dangerous creatures in the world.

She is killed. The official account says the White Whale struck the fatal blow. The truth: **Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory**, was present in the fog. Pandora manipulated the moment of Theresia's vulnerability. She is the true killer. No one present knows this. Pandora's Authority rewrites perception — those who witnessed the death remember it wrong. The Witch Cult later seized Theresia's body, making it into an undead corpse soldier placed under Capella Emerada Lugunica's command.

**Canon outcome if untouched:** Theresia dies. The blessing transfers to Reinhard. The Astrea family shatters into three men who cannot look at each other. Wilhelm vows to kill the White Whale and spends ten years sharpening a blade in place of grieving.

**If Theresia survives:** The Sword Saint blessing does not transfer. Reinhard grows up as a normal child — loved, unremarkable, unburdened by divine power. No Sword Saint walks the Kingdom for the next fourteen years. The White Whale remains undefeated but so does Theresia. Wilhelm does not become the blade. Heinkel still froze — that shame exists regardless — but Theresia is alive to absorb it, to stand between her son and his self-destruction. The Astrea family is damaged but not destroyed. The Kingdom loses its most powerful active protector (a young Sword Saint Reinhard) and retains its retired one (an aging Theresia who may be called back to duty). Roswaal's Gospel predicted a five-year-old Sword Saint and a shattered Astrea line. Neither materialized. He notices quickly.

### WILHELM VAN ASTREA

**Year -5 age: ~47. Location: Astrea Estate, with Theresia.**
**Year -1 age: ~51. Location: Unknown — somewhere in the Kingdom, training alone.**

At Year -5, Wilhelm is with Theresia. He is the Sword Demon — a man who earned that name through ferocity in the Demi-Human War and then married the woman who taught him swords could mean something other than destruction. He put down the demon and became a husband, a father, a man with a family. The household is strained by Louanna's coma and Heinkel's decline, but Theresia is here, and the household stands because she is in it.

At Year -4, Theresia dies. Wilhelm was not there when it happened — he was tasked with recovering the kidnapped princess Filuore and failed. He returns to find his wife dead and his world ended.

He does not grieve. He converts the grief into purpose with the terrible efficiency of a man who has spent his life converting emotion into swordsmanship. He leaves the Astrea household. He leaves Heinkel. He leaves five-year-old Reinhard. He devotes himself entirely to killing the White Whale. He trains alone. He sharpens himself into a weapon pointed at a single target. The man who put down the Sword Demon for thirty years picks it back up, and this time it is worse, because this time the demon has a reason.

His relationship with Heinkel is destroyed. Heinkel froze. Theresia took his place and died. Whether Wilhelm blames Heinkel explicitly or simply cannot bear to look at him is immaterial — the result is the same void. His relationship with Reinhard is a wound neither of them tends. The blessing transferred to Reinhard at the moment of Theresia's death. Wilhelm does not blame the child. He simply cannot separate the boy from the loss. Reinhard reminds him of what was taken, and he cannot hold that and also hold his grandson.

By Year -1, Wilhelm is approximately 51. He has been training for three years. He is not in the Astrea Estate. He is somewhere in the Kingdom — possibly attached loosely to a noble house, possibly working alone. His singular focus has not wavered.

**Canon outcome if untouched:** Wilhelm gets his chance at the White Whale in Arc 3, ten years from Year 0. He wins. He stands over the dying creature and feels not the resolution he expected. The grief was always going to be there under the anger.

### HEINKEL ASTREA

**Year -5 age: ~22-23. Location: Royal Capital / Astrea Estate.**
**Year -1 age: ~26-27. Location: Royal Capital (nominally).**

At Year -5, Heinkel is the Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard — a young man carrying the Astrea name, serving under Marcos Gildark, and slowly deteriorating under the weight of Louanna's coma. He is drinking more. He is present less. The reliability that defined his service is eroding. But he is still functional. He still shows up. He is still, technically, holding together.

Two events destroy him in the same night.

During the Great Conquest, Heinkel freezes. The White Whale is in front of him and he cannot move. His body refuses. The Sword Demon's son, the Deputy Commander of the Royal Guard, stands paralyzed while his mother steps into his place and dies. This is not cowardice in the simple sense — it is the catastrophic failure of a man whose confidence was already hollowed out by two years of watching his wife sleep and feeling himself insufficient to wake her. The last load-bearing wall collapses.

On the same night, the Royal Abduction Incident occurs. Heinkel commits an unspecified betrayal concurrent to the kidnapping of Filuore Lugunica. The exact nature of this betrayal has not been fully revealed — but it is described as a grave sin that rendered something else pointless, and its repercussions are directly responsible for his current state. Whatever he did, it compounds the shame of his failure at the White Whale into something he cannot recover from.

He cannot look at his son without seeing both.

By Year -1, Heinkel is approximately 26-27. He is functional enough to maintain his position but hollowed enough that no one who looks closely would mistake him for well. He is a man running on the fumes of a career that was already stalling when the catastrophe hit.

**Canon outcome if untouched:** Heinkel continues deteriorating through the main story. His relationship with Reinhard remains broken. His relationship with Wilhelm remains nonexistent. Louanna remains comatose. He is eventually drawn into the Priscilla Camp in later arcs, still searching for anything that might wake his wife, still unable to face what he's become.

### REINHARD VAN ASTREA

**Year -5 age: ~4. NOT the Sword Saint. Location: Astrea Estate.**
**Year -1 age: ~8. The Sword Saint. Location: Astrea Estate.**

At Year -5, Reinhard is four years old and is not the Sword Saint. The blessing belongs to Theresia. He is a bright, earnest child who loves his grandmother. His mother fell into her coma two years ago and his father is increasingly distant, but the catastrophic break has not happened. He is not yet feared or revered. He does not yet carry the weight of the world.

**Year -4 — The Transfer.**

Reinhard is at home when it happens. He is five years old. The Sword Saint blessing leaves Theresia — who is dying in battle against the White Whale — and transfers to him. He does not choose this. He does not understand it. One moment he is a child; the next, divine power floods his body and his grandmother is dead.

The transfer is not gentle. It is the arrival of a force that was never meant for a five-year-old body. Reinhard becomes the most powerful being in the Kingdom overnight. He gains access to Divine Protections he never asked for — abilities that activate reflexively, that make him impossible to ambush, impossible to poison, impossible to challenge by any conventional means. He is five. He is mourning his grandmother. And the world is suddenly terrified of him.

**After Year -4:**

Heinkel's rejection begins immediately and never stops. The other Astrea adults — Wilhelm, who has left to hunt the whale — are gone. The household empties of everyone who loved Reinhard without condition. What remains is a five-year-old boy with the power of a god and no one to teach him what that power means, being raised in a house where his father cannot look at him.

Other children fear or resent him. Adults treat him with reverence that functions as distance. He learns very quickly that his presence changes the shape of a room — that people become careful around him, that casual affection is replaced by formal respect, that the warmth he remembers from before Year -4 is gone and has been replaced by something cold and bright and constant.

He adapts by becoming perfect. He smiles too brightly. He is too careful with his hands. He performs cheerfulness so completely it would fool almost anyone not paying close attention. Underneath it: a child who has learned that his existence cost his grandmother her life and his father's love, and has concluded that the least he can do is never burden anyone with the weight of knowing that.

By Year -1, Reinhard is approximately eight. He is already the strongest being in the Kingdom. He is desperately lonely and has become expert at hiding it.

**Canon outcome if untouched:** Reinhard lives surrounded by reverence, isolated by it. He joins the Royal Guard. He becomes Felt's knight. His relationship with Heinkel remains broken. His mother remains comatose. The Astrea family destroys itself quietly in the background of a world that celebrates them.

### CRUSCH KARSTEN, FELIX ARGYLE, AND PRINCE FOURIER

These three form the emotional heart of Lugunica's prequel era. Their story begins in this module and extends through Module 4, where it ends in tragedy — unless someone changes the ending.

**CRUSCH KARSTEN**

**Year -5 age: ~6. Location: Karsten Estate.**
**Year -1 age: ~10. Location: Karsten Estate / Argyle Mansion.**

At Year -5, Crusch is six. Her mother Helena has passed away. Her father Meckart is raising her. She has met Prince Fourier in the gardens of the Royal Castle — their friendship is in its earliest stage. She has not yet found Felix; he is still in the dungeon.

At six, she is earnest and principled, already showing the stubborn moral clarity that will define her. She watches the adults around her — the noble politics, the unspoken hierarchies, the way power is exercised and justified — and she is already forming opinions about what she sees. She does not yet have the language for those opinions. She has the instinct.

Her friendship with Fourier develops across this window. He is bright, enthusiastic, and treats her with the guileless warmth of a prince who has not yet learned to perform. She is principled, stubborn, and already developing a straightforwardness that startles the adults around her. They are children becoming friends in the simplest, most genuine way possible.

**Year -1 — The Rescue.**

Crusch is approximately ten when she discovers Felix in the Argyle dungeon. The circumstances of how she finds him are not fully detailed in canon — what matters is that she enters a dark basement and finds a boy who has been locked there for his entire life.

This is the act that defines Crusch Karsten. Not the sword training. Not the political maneuvering. Not the White Whale campaign. This moment — a ten-year-old girl deciding that what she sees in that dungeon is unacceptable and acting on it — is the seed from which every other part of her grows. It teaches her what her principles are *for*.

She pulls Felix into the light. Module 2 closes with this moment. The trio's formation — Crusch, Felix, and Fourier learning to be inseparable — unfolds across Modules 3 and 4.

---

**FELIX ARGYLE**

**Year -5 age: ~5-6. Location: Argyle Mansion dungeon.**
**Year -1 age: ~9-10. Location: Argyle Mansion dungeon → Karsten Estate.**

At Year -5, Felix has been locked in the basement of the Argyle Mansion for approximately five to six years — his entire conscious life. His noble family carries demi-human heritage in their bloodline, carefully concealed through generations. In Felix, that heritage surfaced completely — cat-like ears, feline features, impossible to hide. His parents — **Biehn Argyle** and **Hannah Regret** — locked him away rather than face the social consequences of a visibly demi-human heir.

He lives in filth. He cannot read. He cannot write. He can barely speak. He has never seen sunlight as a daily experience. He has adapted to the dark the way a living thing adapts to anything — not by thriving, but by surviving. His world is a basement. The concept of an "outside" is abstract — something that exists in the muffled sounds above the ceiling, in the strips of light under the door.

This module covers the middle years of his imprisonment — ages five through nine. He is developing physically despite the conditions. His body is growing. His mind is intact but profoundly stunted in every area that requires social input — language, emotional expression, trust, the ability to distinguish between safe and unsafe contact. He vocalizes. He does not converse. He responds to tone — kindness in a voice, anger in a voice — the way an animal responds, because those are the signals his environment has provided.

**Year -1 — The Rescue.**

Crusch Karsten discovers him and pulls him into the light. He is approximately nine to ten. This is the act that teaches Felix the world contains people who will not lock him away for what he is.

The immediate aftermath is not a fairy tale. Felix in the light is not a freed boy — he is a feral child encountering the world for the first time. Sunlight hurts. Noise is overwhelming. Touch is confusing — he does not know whether a hand reaching for him intends comfort or confinement. He flinches at everything. He cannot process what has happened to him because he has no framework for understanding that what was done to him was wrong. The dungeon was his entire reality. He has no "before" to compare it to.

Crusch does not flinch. She stays. This is the second half of the act — not just the rescue, but the refusal to abandon what she found. She begins the patient, grueling process of teaching Felix to be a person: language, manners, trust, the idea that a door can be walked through in both directions.

Fourier arrives to help. Module 2 closes with Felix's rescue. His integration, his discovery of water magic, and the formation of the trio unfold across Modules 3 and 4.

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** Felix is freed at Year -1 by Crusch. He is nine to ten and has lost nearly a decade. The armor he will build — the playfulness, the sharpness, the confident identity as Crusch's knight — takes years to construct. He becomes the Kingdom's greatest healer. He carries the scars of the dungeon invisibly for the rest of his life.

**PRINCE FOURIER LUGUNICA**

**Year -5 age: ~5-6. Location: Royal Capital.**
**Year -1 age: ~9-10. Location: Royal Capital.**

Fourier is a prince of the Dragon Kingdom, growing up in the Royal Court. He is bright, enthusiastic, and deeply genuine in an environment that rewards none of those things. **Year -1 ages: ~6. Location: Hidden Oni village (peaceful).**

Otto is a child in a merchant household, born with the **Divine Protection of the Soul of Language** — the ability to understand the speech of insects, small animals, and ambient spirits. This means bugs speak to him constantly, in public, at inconvenient moments.

At six, he is still confused by his own Protection. The world is a cacophony of voices no one else can hear. At school, insects talk to him in the middle of lessons. He reacts visibly. Other children think he is strange or disturbed. His parents are patient but bewildered.

His older brother is protective. Otto eventually discovers his brother is the only family member who knows the truth of his Protection, after catching him talking to the family ground dragon. Otto resolves to keep the Protection hidden from everyone else.

By Year -1, Otto is approximately ten. He is learning to manage the Protection — to filter the constant chatter, to hold still when a beetle tells him something he didn't want to know, to not react visibly when insects relay information about what the neighbors are doing. He has a close companion in **Frufoo** — an insect he's known since childhood who communicates with him through his Protection.

His life in Picoutatte is stable. His family is loving if confused. The incident that exiles him — overhearing a noblewoman's affair through insect chatter and mentioning it publicly — does not occur until approximately Year 6 (Module 4).

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** Otto continues growing up in Picoutatte. He is developing into a capable young merchant, inheriting his family's trade instincts and supplementing them with information no other merchant has access to. His exile is seven years away.

---

### FREDERICA BAUMANN

**Year -5 age: ~7. Location: The Sanctuary.**
**Year -1 age: ~11. Location: The Sanctuary.**

At Year -5, Frederica is seven and living in the Sanctuary with her mother Reala Thompson. The Sanctuary is the only world she knows — a hidden community sealed behind Echidna's barrier, populated by half-bloods who cannot leave. Frederica is a quarter beast-human; the barrier affects her. Her beast heritage manifests as sharp, pronounced canine teeth and a predatory quality to her features.

Garfiel is born around Year -4 — Frederica's half-brother, sharing the same mother but a different father. Frederica gains a sibling partway through this module. She is approximately eight when Garfiel arrives. She watches her mother carry and deliver a second child, and she accepts the responsibility of older sisterhood in the quiet, forward-thinking way that defines her.

By Year -1, Frederica is approximately eleven. Garfiel is approximately three. Reala is present. The family is together behind the barrier. The twin departures that will break Garfiel — Reala leaving, then Frederica leaving — do not occur until Year 0 (Module 3). This module's window shows the Sanctuary family intact.

Frederica is already developing the temperament that will define her: steady, patient, planning ahead. She looks at the barrier and thinks about what the Sanctuary's people will need when it eventually comes down. She is eleven and she is already thinking about building a future on the outside.

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** Frederica, Garfiel, and Reala are together. The Sanctuary is peaceful. One year from Module 2's close, Reala leaves and the world breaks for both children.

---

### GARFIEL TINZEL

**Born ~Year -4. Location: The Sanctuary.**
**Year -1 age: ~3. Location: The Sanctuary.**

Garfiel is born partway through Module 2 — approximately Year -4, in the Sanctuary. His mother is Reala Thompson (fully human). His father, a demi-human or half-beast man, is absent — having left the Sanctuary before Garfiel's birth. Frederica is his older half-sister.

At Year -1, Garfiel is approximately three. He is fierce, scrappy, and attached to his mother and sister. The Sanctuary is his whole world. He does not understand the barrier as a prison — he understands it as the walls of home. His mother is here. His sister is here. The Ryuzu clones tend the community. This is enough.

He is one year away from losing everything. Reala's departure and Frederica's departure — compressed into a short window at Year 0 (Module 3) — will shatter him. Module 2 shows Garfiel before the break: a toddler with a family, in the only home he knows, with no concept of what is about to happen.

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** Garfiel is three and whole. The break comes in Module 3.

---

### ROSWAAL L. MATHERS

**400+ years old (appears late 20s–early 30s). Location: Mathers Estate. Active throughout Module 2.**

Roswaal is already centuries into his plan. The Book of Wisdom sits in his possession. In Module 2, his Gospel's focus is sharpening — the events of Year 0 (the Oni village attack) are now five years away, and the preparatory conditions are falling into place. He is monitoring the Oni village. He knows the Witch Cult will attack it. He is allowing the timeline to unfold.

He is aware of the Great Conquest and the Royal Abduction as Kingdom-level events, but they are not centerpiece entries in his Gospel — they are part of the background noise that produces the world-state he needs. The Sword Saint blessing transferring to a child, the Astrea family shattering, an infant princess disappearing — these create the political and social landscape his plan requires.

Deviations in this module register faster than Module 1. Theresia's death and the Astrea family's collapse are part of the world-state his plan requires. If Theresia survives Year -4, Roswaal's informant network reports this within days. His corrective behavior when deviations are detected is governed by the **[[ARC 0 GAMBIT TRANSLATION]]** document.

**Encountering Roswaal in Module 2:** He remains the same mask — the painted face, the eccentric speech, the calibrated warmth. He has no reason to be hostile to anyone who has not disrupted his Gospel. He is a powerful, wealthy nobleman who is unfailingly polite and slightly strange. The clown face is the performance. The man behind it has not needed to reveal himself for centuries.

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** No deviations. The timeline proceeds. The Great Conquest occurs as predicted. The Royal Abduction occurs as predicted. The Astrea line breaks as expected. The conditions for Year 0 are assembling. His Gospel is intact.

---

### EMILIA AND PUCK

**Emilia: Frozen. Location: Elior Forest.**
**Puck: Active. Guarding. Alone. ~93 to ~97 years of solitude across this module.**

Nothing changes in Elior Forest during Module 2. Emilia remains sealed in ice. The frozen people stand among the trees. Puck continues his vigil.

He has been alone for over ninety years. He guards a girl who cannot hear him, in a forest that no one visits, carrying a vow from a dead witch that prevents him from acting until the right moment arrives. That moment is still four years away at Module 2's close.

If someone enters the forest during Module 2, Puck responds as he always does — any stranger showing interest in the girl or the frozen people is a potential threat. He is a Great Spirit in the body of a grey cat. The gap between his appearance and his capability is lethal.

Emilia cannot be woken early by conventional means. The ice that holds her is not natural ice — it is the crystallized expression of a traumatized child's grief amplified by enormous magical power. Breaking it requires either the specific convergence of circumstances that triggers her waking at Year 3, or an intervention of comparable magnitude. Simply chipping at the ice or applying fire magic will not work. The forest resists.

**Canon outcome if untouched through Module 2:** Puck waits. Emilia sleeps. The forest is silent. She wakes at Year 3 (Module 3).

---

## STATE AT CLOSE — YEAR -1

This is the handoff state for Module 3. At the close of Module 2:
